notes.mct_C: Per model and fold, C is taken from the clean-only cache (shortcut); the temperature is refit on the stacked training set's inner OOF logits.
notes.mct_inference_cost: Same feature inputs, model class and cost constants as the clean-trained models: no additional inference cost; MCT changes training data only.
notes.fairness_sign: All gaps are female minus male accuracy (signed). Bootstrap uses common actor draws across systems so differences of gaps are paired.
notes.nested_cost: Escalated clips are charged C_ALL and non-escalated clips their stage-1 cost, as in run_cascade_orders.py.
notes.random_baseline: Expected accuracy of a uniformly random escalation set of size k = round(r*N) is exactly (1-k/N)*acc_stage1 + (k/N)*acc_F-all.
